A separate entity from vegas-connection-wwo (WWO), not a merge — reciprocal to that row's own guard, filed here 2026-09-02 after the PRODIGY diaspora's second wave flagged the pair as unguarded on this side. The identity-join test settles it from both feds' own text rather than from silence. MEMBERS: this team is Aaron Reno and Steven Gage — the AAWC's own Oktoberfest '96 (Night 1) ring announcer, "along with their manager Lady Luck! They are making their return to the AAWC! Here are Aaron Reno and Steven Gage...THE VEGAS CONNECTION!" WWO's team is a different two men entirely: that fed's own tag-team roster page bills "Vegas Connection — 'Lounge Lizard' Lester Leary and Larry Lowbrow", a lounge-act pairing managed by Rimshot, and each man's own bio card names the other as his tag partner. ERA AND PLATFORM: this team runs 1995-96 on the PRODIGY boards; WWO's holds that fed's World Tag Team titles in 2001 on a web-hosted site. PRIOR FEDS: WWO's own bio card for Larry Lowbrow lists where that team had been — the ECCWF, the STWF, the MBC and the PMCW/RCCW/BDCW — and names neither the AAWC nor the CSWA. Four different men, two different managers, five years and two platforms apart, with the WWO team's own travelogue excluding this one's feds. DISTINCT on the documents, not merely unjoined.

notes: Merged from arrogance-aawc. Receipt: the AAWC's own card of 5 August 1995 introduces "Joey Melton and Peyton Wright, collectively known as ARROGANCE" challenging for the AAWC Universal Tag Team titles and says "these two teams have met before in the CSWA." The CSWA tenure above is folded in from that row; data/aliases.json redirects arrogance-cswa to this id. The CSWA record also carries the banner over an earlier pairing — Joey Melton with Steven Flair, World Tag Team champions at ELVIS LIVES VIII in 1994 — recorded in members[] below.

tenures.role: tag team — half of the X-Change side in WAR GAMES: THE MATCH BEYOND
tenures.source: the fed's own served cards, BATTLE OF THE BELTS XIV of 12 July 1996 and FISH FUND XI of 6 September 1996 (promotions/cswa/archive/battle-of-the-belts-xiv-1996-07-12.html, promotions/cswa/archive/fish-fund-xi-night-one-1996.html, promotions/cswa/archive/fish-fund-xi-night-two-1996.html)
tenures.note: BATTLE OF THE BELTS XIV runs Jason Palmer and Dr. Thomas Knight down the aisle into the CS Express/<> Cutters cage match — "They're not in the CSWA!" "They are now, my boy!" — and the broadcast closes the beat with "Thomas Knight made his return, reuniting the Untouchables with the X-Change." FISH FUND XI books them in a match: night one's WAR GAMES: THE MATCH BEYOND has "America's Team" against "the X-Change/Untouchables Team", and night two ends with "the <>Cutters, Nathan Storm, and the UnTouchables" running into the cage. MEMBERSHIP DISAGREES ACROSS THE TWO FEDS AND IS NOT RESOLVED HERE: the AAWC's Oktoberfest '96 card wrestles Benjamin Palmer and Jason Knight as the Untouchables with Dr. Thomas Knight on the apron; the CSWA's cards wrestle Jason Palmer and Dr. Thomas Knight. Dr. Thomas Knight is the one man both feds name identically, and the <> X-Change is the stable both name around this team. The members[] list is left as the AAWC card states it, and the character-level joins are recorded open in data/review-queue.json rather than forced.

caption: Ran down the aisle into a CSWA cage match to reunite with the X-Change, then took a side in WAR GAMES: THE MATCH BEYOND, and won an ugly one at Oktoberfest '96 to book themselves into the following night's AAWC Universal Tag Team title match.
